requirements.statement: A Hotel Manager/Admin can create and manage one or more properties, so the system supports a single hotel or a multi-property chain from one account.

criteria.must: A Hotel Manager/Admin can create a new property with a name, address and currency
A Hotel Manager/Admin can create a second, independent property under the same account
A Hotel Manager/Admin can edit and delete an existing property

requirements.statement: A Hotel Manager/Admin can define room types, room inventory, and base rates for each property.

criteria.must: A Hotel Manager/Admin can create a room type with a name, occupancy and base rate under a property
A Hotel Manager/Admin can edit or remove a room type

requirements.statement: A Hotel Manager/Admin can set date-based rate plans and availability calendars so pricing reflects demand and season.

criteria.must: A Hotel Manager/Admin can create a rate plan with a start date, end date and rate for a room type
A Hotel Manager/Admin can update the number of rooms available on a given date

requirements.statement: A Hotel Manager/Admin can invite and manage Front Desk Staff and Channel Manager Operator accounts for their properties.

criteria.must: A Hotel Manager/Admin can invite a new staff account with a name, email and role (Front Desk Staff or Channel Manager Operator)
A Hotel Manager/Admin can edit or remove an existing staff account
An invited staff member signs in with only the access their assigned role grants

requirements.statement: A Hotel Manager/Admin can view booking and revenue reports across all their properties and channels.

criteria.must: A Hotel Manager/Admin can view a booking report broken down by property and by source (direct vs. channel)
A Hotel Manager/Admin can view a revenue report across their properties and channels

requirements.statement: A Channel Manager Operator can connect a property to one or more OTA channels so its rooms can be sold externally.

criteria.must: A Channel Manager Operator can connect a property to an OTA channel
A Channel Manager Operator can connect the same property to more than one OTA channel
A Channel Manager Operator can disconnect a channel from a property

requirements.statement: Rate and availability changes made in the system automatically push to every connected OTA channel, keeping channel listings accurate.

criteria.must: A rate change made on a room type is pushed out to every OTA channel the property is connected to
An availability change made on a room type is pushed out to every OTA channel the property is connected to

requirements.statement: A booking made on a connected OTA channel automatically appears in the system and reduces availability everywhere else, preventing overselling across channels.

criteria.must: A booking notification received from a connected OTA channel creates a reservation in the system tagged with its channel source
After a channel booking is received, the room's remaining availability decreases for direct booking and for every other connected channel

requirements.statement: A Channel Manager Operator can see the sync status and history of each channel connection and is alerted to sync failures or conflicts.

criteria.must: A Channel Manager Operator can view the current status (connected/disconnected/error) of each channel connection
A Channel Manager Operator can view a history of past sync events (push and pull) for a channel connection
A failed sync is visibly flagged to the Channel Manager Operator

requirements.statement: Front Desk Staff can search availability and create a walk-in or phone reservation for a guest.

criteria.must: Front Desk Staff can search room availability for a property, date range and guest count
Front Desk Staff can create a reservation for a guest without the guest booking online themselves

requirements.statement: Front Desk Staff can view, modify, and cancel existing reservations regardless of booking source, to manage the property's full booking calendar.

criteria.must: Front Desk Staff can view a list of every reservation for a property, direct and channel-sourced alike
Front Desk Staff can modify the dates of an existing reservation
Front Desk Staff can cancel any existing reservation regardless of its source

requirements.statement: Front Desk Staff can check guests in and out and record room/occupancy status to manage day-to-day operations.

criteria.must: Front Desk Staff can mark a reservation as checked in
Front Desk Staff can mark a reservation as checked out

requirements.statement: A Guest can search for available rooms by property, dates, and guest count to find a room that fits their trip.

criteria.must: A Guest can search for available rooms specifying a property, check-in date, check-out date and guest count
Search results only show room types with availability for the requested dates and capacity

requirements.statement: A Guest can book a room and pay online at the time of booking so the reservation is confirmed immediately.

criteria.must: A Guest can complete a booking by paying online through the Sampath Bank payment gateway
A successful payment confirms the reservation immediately
A declined or failed payment does not create a confirmed reservation

requirements.statement: A Guest receives a booking confirmation and can view or cancel their own upcoming reservations.

criteria.must: A Guest receives an email confirmation when their booking is made
A Guest who opted in also receives a WhatsApp confirmation message when their booking is made
A Guest receives a confirmation (email, and WhatsApp if opted in) when they cancel a booking
A Guest can view a list of their own upcoming reservations
A Guest can cancel one of their own upcoming reservations
A Guest cannot view or cancel another guest's reservation

requirements.statement: A Guest can sign in to the booking site so their reservations are tied to their account.

criteria.must: A Guest can sign in via SSO before completing a booking
Reservations made while signed in are associated with the Guest's account and appear in their own reservations list

requirements.statement: Each property prices and sells in a single configured currency; multi-currency and FX conversion are not supported in this version.

criteria.must: A property has exactly one configured currency and all its rates display in that currency
